comment: Every model of the humanoid family that build.py makes (GM2-P9): its name (its path under Assets/Models/humanoid without .glb, so models.pak's entry is models/humanoid/<name>; the sample's apart), its builder (module:function in this package, called with the .glb's path, then the args, then its detail level, levels.py, as `level`), its level and where its .glb goes (relative to engine/). Bodies carry their skeleton and plain outfit; a part made on a body is parts/<category>/<part>/<body> (a mark, made for each face, parts/marks/<mark>/<face>/<body>: GM2 step 9a, Q65), a garment of gear gear/<item>/<body>, a rigid item gear/<item>; the family's clip library is clips (every clips/*.json, the 34 approved clips: GM2 step 4b), Assets/Models/humanoid/clips.glb, so models.pak's models/humanoid/clips; the nine race emblems are emblems/<name>, the name a race's emblem (GM2 step 10: emblems/medallion.py, no level). The game ships the full level (GM2-P20). Test data, not art and never packed: the frame's sample, test-clips (the clip frame's test clip, rest-sway, from the tests' data) and battle/ (the first humanoid's geared man at the battle's level, proven and measured until the battle comes, GM5).
